phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لا يَصِفُهُ نَعْتُ الْوَاصِفِينَ ،
phrases.english: 1.O God, O He whom the depiction of the describers fails to describe!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يُجَاوِزُهُ رَجَاءُ الرَّاجِينَ ،
phrases.english: 2.O He beyond whom passes not the hope of the hopers!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَضِيعُ لَدَيْهِ أَجْرُ الْمُحْسِنِينَ،
phrases.english: 3.O He with whom is not lost the wage of the good-doers!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ مُنْتَهَى خَوْفِ الْعَابِدِيْنَ،
phrases.english: 4.O He who is the ultimate object of the fear of the worshipers!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ هُوَ غَايَةُ خَشْيَةِ الْمُتَّقِينَ.
phrases.english: 5.O He who is the utmost limit of the dread of the godfearing!

phrases.arabic: هَذا مَقَامُ مَنْ تَدَاوَلَتْهُ أَيْدِي الذُّنُوبِ ،
phrases.english: 6.This is the station of him whom sins have passed from hand to hand.

phrases.arabic: وَقَادَتْهُ أَزِمَّةُ الْخَطَايَا ،
phrases.english: 7.Offenses' reins have led him on,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتَحْوَذَ عَلَيْهِ الشَّيْطَانُ،
phrases.english: 8.and Satan has gained mastery over him.

phrases.arabic: فَقَصَّرَ عَمَّا أَمَرْتَ بِهِ تَفْرِيطَاً،
phrases.english: 9.He fell short of what You hast commanded through neglect

phrases.arabic: وَتَعَاطى مَا نَهَيْتَ عَنْهُ تَغْرِيراً،
phrases.english: 10.and he pursued what You hast prohibited in delusion,

phrases.arabic: كَالْجاهِلِ بِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَيْهِ،
phrases.english: 11.like one ignorant of Your power over him

phrases.arabic: أَوْ كَالْمُنْكِرِ فَضْلَ إحْسَانِكَ إلَيْهِ،
phrases.english: 12.or one who denies the bounty of Your beneficence toward him,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى إذَا انْفَتَحَ لَهُ بَصَرُ الْهُدَى،
phrases.english: 13.until, when the eye of guidance was opened for him

phrases.arabic: وَتَقَشَّعَتْ عَنْهُ  سَحَائِبُ الْعَمَى أَحْصَى مَا ظَلَمَ بِهِ نَفْسَهُ،
phrases.english: 14.and the clouds of blindness were dispelled, he reckoned that through which he had wronged himself

phrases.arabic: وَفَكَّرَ فِيمَا خَالَفَ بِهِ رَبَّهُ،
phrases.english: 15.and reflected upon that in which he had opposed his Lord.

phrases.arabic: فَرَأى كَبِيْرَ عِصْيَانِهِ كَبِيْراً، وَجَلِيل مُخالفَتِهِ جَلِيْلاً،
phrases.english: 16.He saw his vast disobedience as vast and his great opposition as great.

phrases.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ نَحْوَكَ مُؤَمِّلاً لَكَ، مُسْتَحْيِيَاً مِنْكَ،
phrases.english: 17.So turned to You, hoping in You and ashamed before You,

phrases.arabic: وَوَجَّهَ رَغْبَتَهُ إلَيْكَ  ثِقَةً بِكَ،
phrases.english: 18.and he directed his beseeching toward You, having trust in You.

phrases.arabic: فَأَمَّكَ بِطَمَعِهِ يَقِيناً، وَقَصَدَكَ بِخَوْفِهِ إخْلاَصَاً،
phrases.english: 19.He repaired to You in his longing with certitude and he went straight to You in fear with sincerity.

phrases.arabic: قَدْ خَلاَ طَمَعُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَطْمُوع فِيهِ غَيْرِكَ،
phrases.english: 20.His longing was devoid of every object of longing but You,

phrases.arabic: وَأَفْرَخَ رَوْعُهُ مِنْ كُلِّ مَحْذُور مِنْهُ سِوَاكَ،
phrases.english: 21.and his fright departed from every object of fear but You.

phrases.arabic: فَمَثَّلَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْـكَ مُتَضَرِّعـاً،
phrases.english: 22.So he stood before You pleading,

phrases.arabic: وَغَمَّضَ بَصَرَهُ إلَى الأرْضِ مُتَخَشِّعَاً،
phrases.english: 23.his eyes turned toward the ground in humbleness,

phrases.arabic: وَطَأطَأَ رَأسَهُ لِعِزَّتِكَ مُتَذَلِّلاً،
phrases.english: 24.his head bowed before Your might in lowliness;

phrases.arabic: وَأَبَثَّكَ مِنْ سِرِّهِ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنْهُ خَضُوعاً،
phrases.english: 25.he revealed to You in meekness those secrets of his which You knowest better than he;

phrases.arabic: وَعَدَّدَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِهِ مَا أَنْتَ أَحْصَى لَهَا خُشُوعاً
phrases.english: 26.he numbered for You in humility those sins of his which You countest better than he;

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتَغَاثَ بِكَ مِنْ عَظِيمِ مَاوَقَعَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِكَ
phrases.english: 27.he sought help from You before the dreadful into which he has fallen in Your knowledge

phrases.arabic: وَقَبِيحِ مَا فَضَحَهُ فِي حُكْمِكَ
phrases.english: 28.and the ugly which has disgraced him in Your judgement:

phrases.arabic: مِنْ ذُنُوب أدْبَرَتْ لَذَّاتُهَا فَذَهَبَتْ،
phrases.english: 29.the sins whose pleasures have turned their backs and gone

phrases.arabic: وَأَقَامَتْ تَبِعَاتُهَا فَلَزِمَتْ،
phrases.english: 30.and whose evil consequences have stayed and stuck fast.

phrases.arabic: لا يُنْكِرُ يَا إلهِي عَدْلَكَ إنْ عَاقَبْتَهُ،
phrases.english: 31.He will not deny Your justice, my God, if You punishest him,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَسْتَعْظِمُ عَفْوَكَ إنْ عَفَوْتَ عَنْهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ;
phrases.english: 32.nor will he consider Your pardon great if You pardonest him and hast mercy upon him,

phrases.arabic: لأِنَّكَ الرَّبُّ الْكَرِيمُ
phrases.english: 33.for You art the Generous Lord

phrases.arabic: الَّذِي لا يَتَعَاظَمُهُ غُفْرَانُ الذَّنْبِ الْعَظِيم.
phrases.english: 34.for whom the forgiveness of great sins is nothing great!

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ فَهَا أَنَا ذَا قَدْ جئْتُكَ مُطِيعاً
phrases.english: 35.O God, so here I am: I have come to You obeying Your command

phrases.arabic: لاِمْرِكَ فِيمَا أَمَرْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ،
phrases.english: 36.(for You hast commanded supplication)

phrases.arabic: مَتَنَجِّزاً وَعْدَكَ فِيمَا وَعَدْتَ بِهِ مِنَ الإجَابَةِ إذْ تَقُولُ
phrases.english: 37.and asking the fulfilment of Your promise, (for You hast promised to respond):

phrases.arabic: (اُدْعُونِي أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ).
phrases.english: 38.You hast said, "Supplicate Me and I will respond to you" (40:60).

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 39.O God, so bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَالْقَنِي بِمَغْفِـرَتِكَ كَمَا لَقِيتُكَ بِإقْرَارِي
phrases.english: 40.meet me with Your forgiveness just as I have met You with my confession,

phrases.arabic: وَارْفَعْنِي عَنْ مَصَارعِ الذُّنُوبِ كَمَا وَضَعْتُ لَكَ نَفْسِي
phrases.english: 41.lift me up from the fatal infirmities of sins just as I have let myself down before You,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتُرْنِي بِسِتْرِكَ كَمَا تَأَنَّيْتَنِي عَنِ الانْتِقَامِ مِنِّي.
phrases.english: 42.and cover me with Your covering just as You hast shown no haste to take vengeance on me!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَثَبِّتْ فِي طَاعَتِكَ نِيَّتِيْ،
phrases.english: 43.O God, make firm my intention to obey You,

phrases.arabic: وَأَحْكِمْ فِي عِبَادَتِكَ بَصِيـرَتِي،
phrases.english: 44.strengthen my insight in worshipping You,

phrases.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنِي مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ
phrases.english: 45.give me the success of works

phrases.arabic: لِمَا تَغْسِلُ بِهِ دَنَسَ الخَطَايَا عَنِّي،
phrases.english: 46.which will wash away the defilement of offenses,

phrases.arabic: وَتَوَفَّنِي عَلَى مِلَّتِكَ وَمِلَّةِ نَبِيِّكَ
phrases.english: 47.and take me when You takest me in the creed of Your prophet

phrases.arabic: مُحَمَّد عَلَيْهِ السَّـلامُ إذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي.
phrases.english: 48.Muhammad (upon him be peace).

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَتُوبُ إلَيْـكَ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا
phrases.english: 49.O God, I repent to You in this my station from

phrases.arabic: مِنْ كَبَائِرِ ذُنُوبِي وَصَغَائِرِهَا
phrases.english: 50.my sins, great and small,

phrases.arabic: وَبَوَاطِنِ سَيِّئآتِي وَظَوَاهِرِهَا،
phrases.english: 51.my evil deeds, inward and outward,

phrases.arabic: وَسَوالِفِ زَلاَّتِي وَحَوَادِثِهَا،
phrases.english: 52.my lapses, past and recent,

phrases.arabic: تَوْبَةَ مَنْ لا يُحَدِّثُ نَفْسَهُ بِمَعْصِيَةٍ
phrases.english: 53.with the repentance of one who does not tell himself that he might disobey

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ يُضْمِرُ أَنْ يَعُودَ فِي خَطِيئَةٍ،
phrases.english: 54.or secretly think that he might return to an offense.

phrases.arabic: وَقَدْ قُلْتَ يَا إلهِي فِي مُحْكَمِ كِتابِكَ
phrases.english: 55.You hast said, my God, in the firm text of Your Book,

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ تَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِكَ،
phrases.english: 56.that You 'acceptest repentance from Your servants,

phrases.arabic: وَتَعْفُو عَنِ السَّيِّئاتِ، وَتُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ،
phrases.english: 57.pardonest evil deeds' (ref.42:25), and lovest the repenters (ref.2:222),

phrases.arabic: فَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي كَمَا وَعَدْتَ وَأعْفُ عَنْ سَيِّئاتِي كَمَا ضَمِنْتَ،
phrases.english: 58.so accept my repentance as You hast promised, pardon my evil deeds as You hast guaranteed,

phrases.arabic: وَأَوْجِبْ لِي مَحَبَّتَكَ كَمَا شَـرَطْتَ،
phrases.english: 59.and make obligatory toward me Your love as You hast stipulated!

phrases.arabic: وَلَـكَ يَـا رَبِّ شَـرْطِي أَلاّ أَعُودَ فِي مَكْرُوهِكَ،
phrases.english: 60.To You, my Lord, belongs my stipulation that I will not return to what is disliked by You,

phrases.arabic: وَضَمَانِي أَلاّ أَرْجِعَ فِي مَذْمُومِكَ،
phrases.english: 61.my guarantee that I will not go back to what You blamest,

phrases.arabic: وَعَهْدِي أَنْ أَهْجُرَ جَمِيعَ مَعَاصِيكَ.
phrases.english: 62.and my covenant that I will stay away from acts of disobedience to You.

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا عَمِلْتُ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا عَلِمْتَ،
phrases.english: 63.O God, You knowest better what I have done, so forgive me what You knowest

phrases.arabic: وَاصْرِفْنِي بِقُدْرَتِكَ إلَى مَا أَحْبَبْتَ.
phrases.english: 64.and turn me through Your power to what You lovest!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَعَلَيَّ تَبِعَاتٌ قَدْ حَفِظْتُهُنَّ،
phrases.english: 65.O God, counted against me are claims that stay in my memory

phrases.arabic: وَتَبِعَاتٌ قَدْ نَسيتُهُنَّ،
phrases.english: 66.and claims that I have forgotten,

phrases.arabic: وَكُلُّهُنَّ بِعَيْنِكَ الَّتِي لاَ تَنَـامُ،
phrases.english: 67.while all of them remain in Your eye that does not sleep

phrases.arabic: وَعِلْمِكَ الَّذِي لا يَنْسَى
phrases.english: 68.and Your knowledge that does not forget!

phrases.arabic: فَعَوِّضْ مِنْهَا أَهْلَهَا وَاحْطُطْ عَنّي وِزْرَهَا،
phrases.english: 69.So compensate their owners, lighten their load upon me,

phrases.arabic: وَخَفِّفْ عَنِّي ثِقْلَهَا، وَاعْصِمْنِي مِنْ أَنْ اُقَارِفَ مِثْلَهَا.
phrases.english: 70.lift up their weight from me, and preserve me from approaching their like!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنَّهُ لاَ وَفَاءَ لِي بِالتَّوْبَةِ إلاَّ بِعِصْمَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 71.O God, but I can not be faithful to my repentance without Your preservation,

phrases.arabic: وَلا اسْتِمْسَاكَ بِي عَنِ الْخَطَايَا إلاَّ عَنْ قُوَّتِكَ،
phrases.english: 72.nor can I refrain from offenses without Your strength.

phrases.arabic: فَقَوِّنِي بِقُوَّة كَافِيَة، وَتَوَلَّنِي بِعِصْمَة مَانِعَة.
phrases.english: 73.So strengthen me with a sufficient strength and attend to me with a defending preservation!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ أَيُّما عَبْد تَابَ إلَيْكَ
phrases.english: 74.O God, if any servant repents to You,

phrases.arabic: وَهُوَ فِي عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ فَاسِخٌ لِتَوْبَتِهِ
phrases.english: 75.while in Your knowledge of the Unseen he will break his repentance

phrases.arabic: وَعَائِدٌ فِي ذَنْبِهِ وَخَطِيئَتِهِ
phrases.english: 76.and return to his sin and offense,

phrases.arabic: فَإنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ أنْ أَكُوْنَ كَذلِكَ،
phrases.english: 77.I seek refuge in You lest I be like that!

phrases.arabic: فَاجْعَلْ تَوْبَتِي هَذِهِ تَوْبَةً لا أَحْتَاجُ بَعْدَهَا إلَى تَوْبَة،
phrases.english: 78.So make this my repentance a repentance after which I will need no repentance

phrases.arabic: تَوْبَةً مُوجِبَةً لِمَحْوِ مَا سَلَفَ، وَالسَّلاَمَةِ فِيمَـا بَقِيَ.
phrases.english: 79.and a repentance which will obligate the erasing of what has gone by and safety in what remains!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَعْتَـذِرُ إلَيْـكَ مِنْ جَهْلِي،
phrases.english: 80.O God, I ask pardon from You for my ignorance,

phrases.arabic: وَأَسْتَـوْهِبُـكَ سُوْءَ فِعْلِي،
phrases.english: 81.and I ask You to disregard my evil acts!

phrases.arabic: فَـاضْمُمْنِي إلَى  كَنَفِ رَحْمَتِكَ تَطَوُّلاً،
phrases.english: 82.So join me to the shelter of Your mercy through graciousness

phrases.arabic: وَاسْتُرْنِي بِسِتْرِ عَافِيَتِكَ تَفَضُّلاً.
phrases.english: 83.and cover me with the covering of Your well-being through bounteousness!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَإنِّي أَتُوبُ إلَيْكَ
phrases.english: 84.O God, I repent to You

phrases.arabic: مِنْ كُلِّ مَا خَالَفَ إرَادَتَكَ
phrases.english: 85.from everything opposed to Your will

phrases.arabic: أَوْ زَالَ عَنْ مَحَبَّتِـكَ
phrases.english: 86.or far from Your love -

phrases.arabic: مِنْ خَـطَرَاتِ قَلْبِي
phrases.english: 87.the thoughts of my heart,

phrases.arabic: وَلَحَـظَاتِ عَيْنِي
phrases.english: 88.the glances of my eye,

phrases.arabic: وَحِكَايَاتِ لِسَانِي،
phrases.english: 89.the tales of my tongue -

phrases.arabic: تَوْبَةً تَسْلَمُ بِهَا كُلُّ جَارِحَة عَلَى حِيَالِهَا مِنْ تَبِعَاتِكَ،
phrases.english: 90.with a repentance through which each bodily part will by itself stay safe from ill consequences with You

phrases.arabic: وَتَأْمَنُ مِمَّا يَخَافُ الْمُعْتَدُونَ  مِنْ أَلِيْمِ سَطَوَاتِكَ.
phrases.english: 91.and remain secure from Your painful penalties feared by transgressors!

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ فَارْحَمْ وَحْدَتِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 92.O God, so have mercy on my being alone before You,

phrases.arabic: وَوَجِيبَ قَلْبِي مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 93.the pounding of my heart in dread of You,

phrases.arabic: وَاضْطِرَابَ أَرْكَانِي مِنْ هَيْبَتِكَ،
phrases.english: 94.the trembling of my limbs in awe of You!

phrases.arabic: فَقَدْ أَقَامَتْنِي يَا رَبِّ ذُنُوبِي مَقَامَ الْخِزْيِ بِفِنَائِكَ،
phrases.english: 95.My sins, my God, have stood me in the station of degradation in Your courtyard.

phrases.arabic: فَإنْ سَكَتُّ لَمْ يَنْطِقْ  عَنِّي أَحَدٌ،
phrases.english: 96.If I remain silent, none will speak for me;

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ شَفَعْتُ فَلَسْتُ بِأَهْلِ الشَّفَاعَةِ.
phrases.english: 97.if I seek an intercessor, I am not worthy for intercession.

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 98.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَشَفِّعْ فِي خَطَايَـايَ كَرَمَكَ،
phrases.english: 99.make Your generosity intercede for my offenses,

phrases.arabic: وَعُدْ عَلَى سَيِّئاتِي بِعَفْوِكَ،
phrases.english: 100.follow up my evil deeds with Your pardon,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَجْزِنِي جَزَآئِي مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ
phrases.english: 101.repay me not with the punishment that is my proper repayment,

phrases.arabic: وَابْسُطْ  عَلَيَّ طَوْلَكَ وَجَلِّلْنِي بِسِتْرِكَ،
phrases.english: 102.spread over me Your graciousness, wrap me in Your covering,

phrases.arabic: وَافْعَلْ بِي فِعْلَ عَزِيز تَضَرَّع إلَيْهِ عَبْدٌ ذَلِيلٌ فَرَحِمَهُ،
phrases.english: 103.and do with me what is done by a mighty man, when a lowly slave pleads to him and he shows him mercy,

phrases.arabic: أَوْ  غَنِيٍّ تَعَرَّضَ لَهُ عَبْدٌ فَقِيرٌ فَنَعَشَهُ.
phrases.english: 104.or a rich man, when a poor slave submits himself and he raises him to wealth!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ لاَ خَفِيرَ لِي مِنْكَ فَلْيَخْفُرْنِيْ عِزُّكَ،
phrases.english: 105.O God, I have no protector against You, so let Your might be my protector!

phrases.arabic: وَلا شَفِيعَ لِيْ إلَيْكَ فَلْيَشْفَعْ لِي فَضْلُكَ،
phrases.english: 106.I have no intercessor with You, so let Your bounty be my intercessor!

phrases.arabic: وَقَدْ أَوْجَلَتْنِي خَطَايَايَ فَلْيُؤْمِنِّي عَفْوُكَ،
phrases.english: 107.My offenses have set me quaking, so let Your pardon give me security!

phrases.arabic: فَمَا كُلُّ مَا نَطَقْتُ بِهِ عَنْ جَهْل مِنِّي بِسُوْءِ أَثَرِي،
phrases.english: 108.Not all that I have said rises up from my ignorance of my evil footsteps

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ نِسيَان لِمَا سَبَقَ مِنْ ذَمِيمِ فِعْلِي،
phrases.english: 109.or forgetfulness of my blameworthy acts in the past,

phrases.arabic: وَلكِنْ لِتَسْمَعَ سَمَاؤُكَ وَمَنْ فِيْهَـا،
phrases.english: 110.but in order that Your heaven and those within it

phrases.arabic: وَأَرْضُكَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا مَا أَظْهَرْتُ لَكَ مِنَ النَّدَمِ،
phrases.english: 111.and Your earth and those upon it may hear the remorse which I have professed to You

phrases.arabic: وَلَجَـأتُ إلَيْكَ فِيـهِ مِنَ التَّوْبَـةِ،
phrases.english: 112.and the repentance through which I have sought asylum with You.

phrases.arabic: فَلَعَـلَّ بَعْضَهُمْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَرْحَمُنِي لِسُوءِ مَوْقِفِي،
phrases.english: 113.Then perhaps one of them, through Your mercy, may show mercy upon my evil situation

phrases.arabic: أَوْ تُدْرِكُهُ الرِّقَّةُ عَلَىَّ لِسُوءِ حَالِي
phrases.english: 114.or be seized by tenderness for my evil state.

phrases.arabic: فَيَنَالَنِي مِنْهُ بِدَعْوَةٍ أَسْمَعُ لَدَيْكَ مِنْ دُعَائِي،
phrases.english: 115.There may come from him for my sake a supplication to which You givest ear more than to my supplication

phrases.arabic: أَوْ شَفَاعَـةٍ أَوْكَدُ عِنْدَكَ مِنْ شَفَاعَتِي
phrases.english: 116.or an intercession surer with You than my intercession

phrases.arabic: تَكُونُ بِهَا نَجَاتِي مِنْ غَضَبِكَ وَفَوْزَتِي بِرضَاكَ.
phrases.english: 117.through which I may be delivered from Your wrath and attain to Your good pleasure!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنْ يَكُنِ النَّدَمُ تَوْبَةً إلَيْكَ فَأَنَا أَنْدَمُ اْلنَّادِمِينَ،
phrases.english: 118.O God, if remorse is a repentance toward You, then I am the most remorseful of the remorseful!

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ يَكُنِ التَّرْكُ لِمَعْصِيَتِكَ إنَابَةً فَأَنَا أَوَّلُ الْمُنِيبينَ،
phrases.english: 119.If refraining from disobedience is a turning back to You, then I am the first of those who turn back!

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ يَكُنِ الاسْتِغْفَارُ حِطَّةً لِلذُّنُوبِ فَإنَي لَكَ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ.
phrases.english: 120.If praying for forgiveness alleviates sins, surely I am one of those who pray for Your forgiveness!

phrases.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ فَكَمَا أَمَرْتَ بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَضَمِنْتَ الْقَبُولَ
phrases.english: 121.O God, as You hast commanded repentance and guaranteed acceptance,

phrases.arabic: وَحَثَثْتَ عَلَى الدُّعَـاءِ وَوَعَدْتَ الإجَابَةَ،
phrases.english: 122.as You hast urged supplication, and promised to respond,

phrases.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ وَآلِهِ وَاقْبَلْ تَوْبَتِي
phrases.english: 123.so also bless Muhammad and his Household, accept my repentance,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ تَرْجِعْني مَرجَعَ الخَيبَةِ منْ رَحْمَتِك
phrases.english: 124.and return me not to the returning place of disappointment in Your mercy!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ عَلَى الْمُذْنِبِينَ،
phrases.english: 125.Surely You art "Ever-turning" (2:128) toward the sinners,

phrases.arabic: وَالرَّحِيمُ لِلْخَاطِئِينَ الْمُنِيبِينَ.
phrases.english: 126."All-compassionate" (2:128) toward the offenders who turn back!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا هَدَيْتَنَا بِهِ
phrases.english: 127.O God, bless Muhammad and his Household just as You hast guided us by him!

phrases.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ كَمَا اسْتَنْقَذْتَنَا بِهِ،
phrases.english: 128.Bless Muhammad and his Household just as You hast rescued us through him!

phrases.arabic: وَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ
phrases.english: 129.Bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: صَلاَةً تَشْفَعُ لَنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَيَوْمَ الْفَاقَةِ إلَيْكَ،
phrases.english: 130.with a blessing that will intercede for us on the Day of Resurrection, the day of neediness toward You!

phrases.arabic: إنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْء قَدِيرٌ وَهُوَ عَلَيْكَ يَسِيرٌ .
phrases.english: 131."Thou art powerful over everything" (3:26), and that is easy for You!
